name: Lunara Black
author: Adlux
description: Comfort-wear theme (Lunara / Shrine PRO design): sale bar with countdown, banner, product grid and real reviews on the home page; product page with gallery, Kaching-style bundle packs (per-item Color / Size), description, reviews with write-a-review form and FAQ; cart drawer, Products catalog, About / policy pages, order tracking and checkout. Black edition: primary colour #000000 with glossy buttons, editable. Extra product template "Tredvik – Brixpant bundle": the Tredvik product page (gallery, 1–4 packs with Color / Size per item, picture + text blocks, steps, comparison, customer quotes, FAQ, reviews) inside Lunara's header, footer and cart drawer.
